description_en: You can invoke ListPhoneNumbers to obtain the phone number list under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListPhoneNumbers获取指定实例下的号码列表
name: ListPhoneNumbers

parameters.help_en: Performs fuzzy matching based on the number. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value indicates no filtering
parameters.help_zh: 根据号码进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.help_en: Usage of the number. This parameter is optional. The default value is empty, which means no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 号码的用途，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: usage

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the number is active. This parameter is optional. The default value is empty, which means no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 号码是否可用，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en: The paging ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number
